implementation-request.intent: Applying a promo code after changing quantity leaves cart line items with a null price, causing a blank total on the checkout page.

evidence.report: "cart total is blank after I put in the discount code, happened to two customers today"

diagnosis.file: applyPromo() recomputes line totals but reads price from the pre-quantity-change snapshot
LineItem.price becomes undefined when snapshot is stale

constraints.scope: Only files under src/cart and src/promo unless a test requires otherwise
constraints.tests: Add a regression test covering quantity change followed by promo apply
constraints.forbidden: Do not modify pricing rules or promo eligibility logic
